## 6-Day Itinerary

Day 1: Arrival & Historic Markets

Day 2: Arashiyama Adventures
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b2/Arashiyama_Bamboo_Grove_Kyoto.jpg/1200px-Arashiyama_Bamboo_Grove_Kyoto.jpg Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
